dict.string: Zana is a hands-free voice agent that listens, responds, and uses tools to help you work on your desktop.
Zana needs accessibility access to listen for keyboard shortcuts (Fn key) so you can start recording with a single press.
Zana uses Apple Events to type or paste text, send key presses, read the frontmost app, and run AppleScript tools you request.
Zana needs microphone access to record your voice for transcription.
